adminUsers.passwordRequired: Enter and confirm the new password.

page.title: Payments
page.subtitle: Configure payment methods and the wallet USD/SYP exchange rate.

walletExchange.sectionHelp: Set how many Syrian pounds equal one US dollar. Clients see this next to their balance; the wallet uses it when spending from a mixed USD + SYP balance.
walletExchange.help: Leave empty to clear the rate. Without a rate, only the USD wallet bucket is used for debits.

methods.help: These methods appear when clients add funds from the dashboard.
methods.name: Name
methods.deleteConfirm: Delete this payment method? (Only allowed if it has no requests)
methods.minDepositUsdHelp: Leave empty for no USD minimum. Clients paying in USD must deposit at least this amount.
methods.minDepositSypHelp: Leave empty for no SYP minimum. Clients paying in SYP must deposit at least this amount.

requests.help: Approving credits the user wallet. Platform admin can refund approved payments (credits the client again if needed).
requests.refundConfirm: Refund this payment? This will credit the client's wallet balance.
